fields.name: bannerContent
fields.label: Banner Content
fields.description: Choose what content the banner displays. 'Message only' shows a heading and body text — ideal for announcements or informational strips. 'Message + Action' adds a CTA button — use when you want visitors to take a specific next step.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Main banner headline. Keep it short and impact-driven — this is the first thing visitors read. Required.

fields.name: headingLevel
fields.label: Heading Level
fields.description: Semantic HTML heading tag (H1–H6). Controls page hierarchy for accessibility and SEO — does not change the visual text size. Match the level to where this banner sits on the page.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Message
fields.description: Supporting body text below the heading. One or two sentences that add context — e.g. availability, details, or a benefit statement.

fields.name: icon
fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Icon name from the design system icon library (e.g. 'headset', 'info-circle'). Displayed above the heading. Leave blank to hide the icon.

fields.name: actionText
fields.label: Action Label
fields.description: CTA button label. Keep it short and action-oriented (e.g. 'Contact Support', 'Learn More'). Only rendered when Banner Content is set to 'Message + Action'.

fields.name: actionLink
fields.label: Action Link
fields.description: Destination URL for the CTA button. Pick a page from the content tree or paste an external URL. Only rendered when Banner Content is set to 'Message + Action'.

fields.name: size
fields.label: Size
fields.description: Controls the banner's vertical padding. 'Generous' suits hero-level banners; 'Compact' fits tighter inline positions such as mid-page support strips.

fields.name: alignment
fields.label: Alignment
fields.description: Horizontal alignment of the banner content. 'Center' suits standalone banners; 'Left' works better when adjacent to other elements.

fields.name: column
fields.label: Column Layout
fields.description: 'Two Column' places the CTA button to the right of the content — most useful when Banner Content is 'Message + Action'. 'Single Column' stacks everything vertically.

fields.name: background
fields.label: Background
fields.description: 'Default' is white. 'Subtle' is a light warm off-white. 'Muted' is a soft beige tone — useful for visually separating the banner from white page sections.
